name: Census Income (Adult) Dataset
description: The UCI Adult dataset contains census-derived demographic and employment attributes for predicting whether annual income exceeds $50,000. The record describes the upstream resource only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Kohavi, R. (1996). Scaling Up the Accuracy of Naive-Bayes Classifiers: A Decision-Tree Hybrid. Proceedings of the Second International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, 202–207. Dataset: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/2/adult
